title: Glowing toothbrush
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='handleGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#4fc3f7'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#1976d2'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='headGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#81d4fa'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#29b6f6'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='34' ry='42' fill='#b3e5fc' opacity='0.18'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='26' ry='36' fill='#81d4fa' opacity='0.22'/>

  <!-- handle -->
  <rect x='41' y='48' width='18' height='44' rx='9' fill='url(#handleGrad)'/>
  <rect x='45' y='52' width='4' height='34' rx='2' fill='#b3e5fc' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='42' y='38' width='16' height='14' rx='4' fill='url(#headGrad)'/>

  <!-- brush head -->
  <rect x='38' y='18' width='24' height='24' rx='10' fill='url(#headGrad)'/>
  <rect x='42' y='22' width='5' height='14' rx='2.5' fill='#e1f5fe' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- bristles rows -->
  <g fill='#ffffff'>
    <rect x='43' y='12' width='3' height='8' rx='1.5'/>
    <rect x='48' y='10' width='3' height='10' rx='1.5'/>
    <rect x='53' y='10' width='3' height='10' rx='1.5'/>
    <rect x='58' y='12' width='3' height='8' rx='1.5'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#e1f5fe'>
    <rect x='43' y='14' width='3' height='5' rx='1.5'/>
    <rect x='48' y='12' width='3' height='7' rx='1.5'/>
    <rect x='53' y='12' width='3' height='7' rx='1.5'/>
    <rect x='58' y='14' width='3' height='5' rx='1.5'/>
  </g>

  <!-- sparkle -->
  <g fill='#ffffff'>
    <circle cx='72' cy='26' r='2.5'/>
    <circle cx='28' cy='34' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='68' cy='68' r='2'/>
    <path d='M72 36 L74 41 L79 43 L74 45 L72 50 L70 45 L65 43 L70 41 Z' fill='#e1f5fe'/>
  </g>
</svg>
